khl_club_crosswalk(season: 'Optional[int]' = None, stage: 'Optional[str]' = 'regular', *, tournament_id: 'Optional[int]' = None, return_as_pandas: 'bool' = False, **kwargs: 'Any') -> 'Frame' Club id <-> team-season id for one tournament, read from a covering set of game headers. Fetches the schedule, picks the fewest games (greedy) that touch every club, fetches those game headers (about 15 requests, each waiting its polite second) and maps the ids they carry. Parameters Returns polars.DataFrame | pandas.DataFrame: tournament_id, club_id (stable), team_season_id (this tournament's), one row per club. Raises Example from sportsdataverse.hockey.khl import khl_club_crosswalk xw = khl_club_crosswalk(season=2026) xw.filter(xw["club_id"] == 7)

khl_club_crosswalk_from_frames(*frames: 'Any', return_as_pandas: 'bool' = False) -> 'Frame' Club id <-> team-season id from frames that carry both (game header / info, player career). Parameters Returns polars.DataFrame | pandas.DataFrame: one row per (tournament_id, club_id, team_season_id), all Int64, sorted; zero rows when no frame carries a pair. Raises Example from sportsdataverse.hockey.khl import khl_club_crosswalk_from_frames, khl_game_header khl_club_crosswalk_from_frames(khl_game_header(898236, season=2026))

sportsdataverse.hockey.khl — 14 endpoints. Note: Owner flag (sdv-internal-refs/khl/README.md): the KHL and its webcaster platform are run by Russian operators, some clubs by sanctioned state companies. Fetching on your own machine is fine; any published data release, hosted mirror or redistribution needs owner (sanctions / legal) sign-off first. Note: The documented curl request is schematic: the runtime primes a session (adds the form field sessid), maps season / stage to the form field values[tournament] (the tournament id) and sends the X-Requested-With, Origin and Referer headers.

Season schedule and results of a tournament, one row per game (All-Star games dropped). Endpoint URL: POST https://www.khl.ru/rest/calendar/list/ Example request: curl -X POST 'https://www.khl.ru/rest/calendar/list/' -d 'season=2026&stage=regular'

return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the raw khl.ru envelope Dict ({status, data, errors}).
